system.description:
The rune resembles a knot tied around a small central circle. When hostile spiritual power presses against its wearer, the knot appears to tighten.

You gain a +2-item bonus to saving throws against possession and effects that forcibly remove, control or displace your soul.

Whenever you successfully resist a possession attempt, you are aware that something attempted to enter or control you, even if the effect would normally conceal its presence.

Inscribed onto armour.

On the sheet: Applied automatically: the +2 is pre-ticked on a save against a Soul or possession effect, offered otherwise. The awareness clause is a card line when a save against possession succeeds.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
